item.description: Republican Governor Phil Scott won a sixth term as Vermont governor with Molly Gray winning lieutenant governor. Democrats flipped multiple legislative seats across the state. U.S. Representative Becca Balint was also reelected easily.

Jeff Haylon won the Rutland-nine House District race .Alicia Malay won a second term in the Rutland-eight House District. David Bosch and Thomas Burditt are likely winners in the Rutland-two House race.
A child in Lewis County New York died from measles, the state's first such death in over thirty years. Health officials urge residents to keep up with MMR vaccinations.

Vermont voters approved a constitutional amendment protecting labor union rights. Over seventy-five percent supported Proposition three. The amendment guarantees the right to organize or join unions for collective bargaining.
